Committed BEFORE any read with these exits; code b3/exit_study.py; results research/b3/exit_study/.
question: Does a minute-by-minute profit/loss exit layer turn any registered entry into a net-positive rule? Entries are unchanged; only exits vary.
splits: b3/config/splits_b3.json: exploration 2021-11-16..2024-07-01 only; validation read ONCE per (rule, market, exit) finalist; final test locked.

entries._rules: Agent rules registered and run on WIN, plus any rule registered before the first read of this study. Eligible only with >= 500 trades/yr in the already-recorded exploration row (research/b3/ledger.jsonl), so eligibility needs no new read. P-029 (15/yr) is out.

p004._note: Exploration only for WIN: P-004 WIN validation was already read (2026-11-16). WDO validation unread.

exits._common: Every variant keeps the rule's own stop (or the tighter stop_brl), its time exit and the engine's flatten before the close. Breakeven moves the stop to entry +1 tick in the trade's favour. Trailing arms when the open profit reaches distance_brl and then trails the best price of the PREVIOUS minutes by distance_brl.

simulation.path_bars: 1-minute bars of the exploration split for every rule, whatever its own timeframe; the rule's signals and its own exits are decided on its own bars exactly as in b3/backtest.py.
simulation.same_minute: stop first (worst case) when one minute reaches both the stop and the target
simulation.target_fill: limit order: filled at the target only if the minute trades 1 tick THROUGH it
simulation.stop_fill: at the level (measured: stops filled at the level), plus the side's slippage
simulation.costs: pattern_search_b3.json cost_reevaluation: measured (0.4 tick/side, fees WIN 0.25 / WDO 1.00 BRL) and measured_p90 (1.0 tick/side, fees WIN 0.50 / WDO 1.50 BRL)
simulation.fidelity: X00 must match the official engine (b3/backtest.py) trade for trade; the intra-minute ordering is checked against recorded ticks with RANDOM entries only (no rule signal: the ticks are inside the locked final test)

gate.dsr_trials: all trials already counted on the market (WIN: 561 A+B + 288 C = 849) plus this study's variants

demo._rule: Owner decides. Recommended: demo robots back to the rules' own exits (no BRL cap) and every trade journals MFE, MAE and the counterfactual result of X01..X11 from the live price path. Measurement only; not evidence for the gate.
